$comment: Exceptions to the nightly and pre-release security scans (P07 task 8.1, ADR-0017 §5), checked by scripts/check-security-scan.mjs; see docs/dev/security-scanning.md. A vulnerability exception (scanner pnpm-audit or trivy) names the advisory id (GHSA or CVE), the package, the exact installed versions it covers, its owner, the reason and the review deadline reviewBy (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 180 days ahead); once the deadline has passed every scan fails until it is reviewed and renewed or removed. A gitleaks exception records a finding reviewed as not a secret: its id is the review id (SHA-256 of path, rule and the exact line, as the public export computes it), so any change to the line makes it a new finding. A trivy exception lists the images it covers (images) and covers no other image; the same advisory and package may be excepted again for other versions or images, with its own reason. A finding with a published fix (Trivy FixedVersion, npm patched versions) is fixed, not excepted: an exception covers it only with fixBlockedBy (why the fix cannot be taken yet) and a review deadline at most 30 days ahead. The triage of the image findings is described in docs/dev/security-scanning.md.

exceptions.reason: JWT_SECRET placeholder (replace-me-…) in the example environment file; not a secret.
An API key id of a test fixture (REVOKED_KEY), not a key.
An API key id of a test fixture (OTHER_KEY), not a key.
An elided public key (BEGIN PUBLIC KEY … END PUBLIC KEY) in a configuration example.
Prose of an upstream LumiBase review note; no credential.

libsystemd0 of the Debian 13 postgres:18 base image, linked by the PostgreSQL server for sd_notify only; the finding is a systemd-homed privilege escalation, and the container runs neither systemd nor systemd-homed. Debian defers the fix. Review when Debian ships a fix. Also covers the CMS and rendering-service images (node:24-trixie-slim, the same Debian 13 package and version; extended with the maintainer's approval on 2026-10-28): no package is installed beyond the base (Git snapshots run in process, no git program); node and sharp/libvips link only libc, libstdc++, libgcc_s, libm, libdl, libpthread and libresolv (ldd). The CMS does start programs: the Astro build runner spawns node build children, under prlimit (util-linux) when present; the rendering service starts none.

libtinfo6 (ncurses) of the Debian 13 postgres:18 base image, loaded by psql and by the LLVM JIT for terminal capabilities only; it reads the terminfo database of the image, not data from the database or the network. Debian has published no fixed version. Review when Debian ships a fix. Also covers the CMS and rendering-service images (node:24-trixie-slim, the same Debian 13 package and version; extended with the maintainer's approval on 2026-10-28): no package is installed beyond the base (Git snapshots run in process, no git program); node and sharp/libvips link only libc, libstdc++, libgcc_s, libm, libdl, libpthread and libresolv (ldd). The CMS does start programs: the Astro build runner spawns node build children, under prlimit (util-linux) when present; the rendering service starts none.

libxml2 of the Debian 13 postgres:18 base image, linked by the PostgreSQL server (xml type and functions) and its LLVM JIT; Debian has published no fixed version. The flaws need crafted XML parsed through SQL XML functions (or the Python bindings / xml2 extension); HeoPress has no xml column and calls no XML function; the database port is published only on 127.0.0.1 (docker-compose.yml) and not at all in production (docker-compose.prod.yml). Review when Debian ships a fix.

Debian 13 package of the upstream postgres:18 base image (OS tooling: util-linux, login, GnuPG for apt keys, Perl, ncurses); Debian has published no fixed version (apt-get upgrade at build finds none). Not loaded by the PostgreSQL server or the extensions HeoPress creates (pg_trgm, vector, zhparser): ldd of /usr/lib/postgresql/18/{bin,lib}; libuuid1 only by uuid-ossp, which HeoPress does not create. Review when Debian ships a fix. Also covers the CMS and rendering-service images (node:24-trixie-slim, the same Debian 13 package and version; extended with the maintainer's approval on 2026-10-28): no package is installed beyond the base (Git snapshots run in process, no git program); node and sharp/libvips link only libc, libstdc++, libgcc_s, libm, libdl, libpthread and libresolv (ldd). The CMS does start programs: the Astro build runner spawns node build children, under prlimit (util-linux) when present; the rendering service starts none.

pgvector from the PGDG repository, used by HeoPress vector search; no fixed package is published yet. The flaw is an out-of-bounds write while building an IVFFlat index; HeoPress builds HNSW indexes only, and only the application's own database roles can create indexes. Short review: upgrade as soon as PGDG publishes the fixed pgvector.
